title: fix(ci): judge a partially attested cancelled matrix by each shard's recorded cancel cause (Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate)
body:
Fixes #22653
Clause-②: yes

Ruling executed: `6097061442` on #22653 (letter B, the maintainer's 「同意」). It amends #16157's ruling `5559243179`: on the partial-attestation path, the required check now decides by the cancel cause the platform recorded. That holds for both gates, `Test Core` and `Dogfood Regression Gate`. This is a second caller of the reader PR #22666 landed (`classifyCancelAnnotations` and the attempt-jobs read), and that reader is reused unchanged.

## What changed

**`scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`**

- `shardsNeedingCancelCause(legs, present)` replaces `legsNeedingCancelCause`. It is pure and shared by `judge()` and `--verify`. It asks one question per SHARD, keyed by attestation id:
  - a matrix leg that reads `cancelled` with at least one of its own credentials present: every shard of it with no credential (this card);
  - a single-leg roster that reads `cancelled` with no credential while another leg attested (#22606's path, the same question for a 1-shard roster).
  - It asks nothing for a matrix with zero credentials (#3668's whole-matrix pass, ruled not extended). It also asks nothing for a full roster, or for any result other than `cancelled`, so `failure` keeps dominating.
- `judge()` on the partial path:
  - every asked shard reads as a recorded supersession ⇒ the leg passes, as #3668 passes a whole-matrix supersession, and the log quotes each shard's own cause;
  - any shard killed by its own job timeout ⇒ red, naming that shard and quoting the timeout;
  - any other cause, a manual cancel included, or an unreadable one ⇒ red, naming the shard and why. A shard with no answer counts as unreadable.
  - `judge()` stays pure.
- `readCancelCauses()` reads this attempt's jobs list ONCE (`GET /repos/OWNER/REPO/actions/runs/RUN/attempts/N/jobs`). It then reads one annotations list per asked shard (`GET CHECK_RUN_URL/annotations`).
  - A matrix shard is found by its expanded display name. `workflowJobDisplayName(text, job, shard)` expands a `name:` template whose only expression is `${{ matrix.shard }}`.
  - Measured: the jobs API lists `Test Core (${{ matrix.shard }}/6)` as `Test Core (3/6)` (run 38036705318), and the dogfood matrix as `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` (run 38044009552).
  - Any other expression, or no template, makes the cause unreadable, so the shard is red.
- The static guard (`node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`, run in lint) now covers every leg the read can be asked about, every matrix leg included. It requires:
  - `actions: read` and `checks: read`;
  - `GITHUB_TOKEN` in the `--verify` step's env;
  - for a matrix leg, a name template that the text reading expands exactly as the parsed YAML does, shard by shard.
  - PR #22666's static pin is extended, not paralleled. There is no new gate script.
- The error text keeps the `published no positive attestation (IDS)` shape that `scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs` parses. The single-leg messages are byte-identical to before.

**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `test-gate` only**

- `permissions` gains `actions: read` and `checks: read` beside `contents: read`. Both are read-only, and the ruling names them as a security fact.
- The `Verify test shard results` step's env gains `GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}`.
- No job or step is renamed. `dogfood-gate` already carries both and is not touched.

## Premises, measured before the code

1. **Causes are per shard, not per leg.** Run 38036705318, attempt 1:
   - `Test Core (5/6)` concluded success, with its attestation steps `success`.
   - `Test Core (1/6)`, `(2/6)`, `(3/6)`, `(4/6)` and `(6/6)` were cancelled, with their attestation steps `skipped`.
   - The aggregate `Test Core` concluded failure.
   - Each of the five check runs (114168570857, 114168570799, 114168570849, 114168570868, 114168570842) carries `Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for ci-CI-pull_request-22644 exists`.
   - The landed reader keyed causes by leg job id and returned `undefined` on any name containing an expression. So it is extended to per-shard ids and expanded names, not forked.
2. **The jobs API reports expanded matrix names.** It lists `Test Core (k/6)` and `Dogfood Regression Gate (k/3)`, read off the attempt-jobs lists of runs 38036705318 and 38044009552.
3. **`test-gate` had `contents: read` only and no token** at `243dd3c625`. `dogfood-gate` has carried both since PR #22666.
4. **An own-timeout partial exists in the Actions history.** Run 34007386254, attempt 1, is #16157's own measured run. `Test Core (2/6)` (check run 101417030701) is annotated `The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 30m0s`, and five siblings attested.

## Live replay through `--verify` (real API, at `036dfe5894`)

The credentials were emitted with each run's id and attempt, and the leg results are the runs' own.

Before the change, at `243dd3c625`, run 38036705318 exits 1 with `Test Core: 5 of 6 declared shard(s) of test published no positive attestation (test-1-of-6, test-2-of-6, test-3-of-6, test-4-of-6, test-6-of-6) while 1 sibling(s) did (test-5-of-6). … see #16157.`

Run 38036705318, a partial supersession, exit 0:

```text
Test Core: counting per-shard positive attestations (#6082), not absence of negatives.
  filter job result: success
  run 38036705318, attempt 1
  leg test (declared roster 1..6/6) — aggregate result: cancelled
    satisfied (cancelled AFTER 1 of 6 declared shard(s) attested, and every unattested shard's own check run records a supersession — #3668's pass, by the recorded cause (#22653))
    ~ test-1-of-6  superseded ("Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for ci-CI-pull_request-22644 exists — check run 114168570857")
    ~ test-2-of-6  superseded ("Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for ci-CI-pull_request-22644 exists — check run 114168570799")
    ~ test-3-of-6  superseded ("Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for ci-CI-pull_request-22644 exists — check run 114168570849")
    ~ test-4-of-6  superseded ("Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for ci-CI-pull_request-22644 exists — check run 114168570868")
    + test-5-of-6  (run 38036705318, attempt 1)
    ~ test-6-of-6  superseded ("Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for ci-CI-pull_request-22644 exists — check run 114168570842")
Test Core: satisfied — superseded: 5 unattested shard(s) were cancelled by a recorded supersession (#3668, #22653), after 1 sibling shard(s) of their leg(s) attested.
```

Run 34007386254 attempt 1, an own timeout, exit 1:

```text
Test Core: counting per-shard positive attestations (#6082), not absence of negatives.
  filter job result: success
  run 34007386254, attempt 1
  leg test (declared roster 1..6/6) — aggregate result: cancelled
    cancelled AFTER 5 of 6 declared shard(s) attested, and 1 unattested shard(s) carry no recorded supersession — the roster is REQUIRED and every missing shard is named (#16157, #22653)
    + test-1-of-6  (run 34007386254, attempt 1)
    - test-2-of-6  MISSING — killed by its own job timeout ("The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 30m0s — check run 101417030701")
    + test-3-of-6  (run 34007386254, attempt 1)
    + test-4-of-6  (run 34007386254, attempt 1)
    + test-5-of-6  (run 34007386254, attempt 1)
    + test-6-of-6  (run 34007386254, attempt 1)
    attested 5 / 6 declared shard(s)
::error::Test Core: 1 of 6 declared shard(s) of test published no positive attestation (test-2-of-6) while 5 sibling(s) did (test-1-of-6, test-3-of-6, test-4-of-6, test-5-of-6, test-6-of-6). The leg was cancelled mid-run, so the missing shard(s) produced no verdict at all — an untested shard is not a passing shard, see #16157. Only a recorded supersession excuses a missing shard here (#22653): test-2-of-6: killed by its own job timeout ("The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 30m0s — check run 101417030701").
```

Run 38044009552 (`Dogfood Regression Gate`) exits 0. There, `dogfood (1/3)` was superseded while 2/3 attested, and the CLI leg attested. The log reads `satisfied (cancelled AFTER 2 of 3 declared shard(s) attested, and every unattested shard's own check run records a supersession …)`, quoting `ci-CI-pull_request-22674` from check run 114189818518.

Controls, #22606's single-leg path, unchanged:

- Run 38021470264 exits 1 with the same words as before (`leg dogfood-verify (single leg) … killed by its own job timeout`).
- Run 37984828810 exits 0 (`satisfied (cancelled — superseded, per the leg's own check run …)`).

## Ablation (from the committed state)

- The change was committed first, at `036dfe5894`.
- The mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, with its own EXIT/INT/TERM restore. An outer `trap` also ran `git checkout HEAD --` on the absolute path.
- **Mutation:** in `shardsNeedingCancelCause`, the matrix arm of the `askable` ternary (`attestedAny(leg)`) became `false /* ABLATION-22653 */`. This drops the partial-path cause read and keeps the single-leg one.
- **Proof it landed:** the tool reports anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, and blob `28d73901` to `9209511f`. An on-disk grep inside the run counts the marker 1 and the original 0.
- **Self-test:** exit 1 with 29 failures, every one of them a #22653 case: the superseded partial, the per-shard naming and the reads. The #22606 and #16157 batteries stay green.
- **Replays under the mutation:**
  - run 38036705318 exits 1, so today's false red is back;
  - run 34007386254 exits 1, without the cause;
  - control run 37984828810 exits 0.
- **Restore:** the blob after restore equals HEAD (`28d73901`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Self-test

`node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs --self-test` exits 0 with 290 assertions, up from 218. Three batteries were added, with floors pinned at their measured counts. `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` goes from 19 to 22.

| battery | floor |
|:--|--:|
| `#22653 partial cancel cause: every unattested shard's recorded cause decides` | 32 |
| `#22653 the cause read, offline: one jobs list, then one annotations read per unattested shard` | 21 |
| `#22653 the static guard pins the cause read on every matrix leg, test-gate included` | 19 |

They cover the batteries the dispatch named:

- a superseded partial ⇒ pass;
- one own-timeout shard among superseded shards ⇒ red, naming that shard;
- an unreadable cause ⇒ red;
- a manual cancel ⇒ red;
- every shard cancelled with zero attestations ⇒ pass, with no question asked (#3668, the control);
- the single-leg path ⇒ unchanged (the control).

The existing #22606 cases were re-keyed by attestation id (`dogfood-verify-1-of-1`). Their static fixtures are now scoped to `dogfood-gate`'s own block. Both gates now carry the same permission and token lines, and a first-match `String.replace` would otherwise have moved those fixtures onto `test-gate` silently. One new pin proves the scoping.

## Gates at `036dfe5894`

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derives 57 commands, matching the dispatch's 57. Each exit code was captured by redirect, never through a pipe.

- **53 exit 0.** These include:
  - `pnpm check:shard-attestation` and `pnpm check:required-contexts`;
  - `node scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs`, plus its `--self-test`;
  - `pnpm check:workflow-status-functions` and `pnpm check:workflow-step-name-quoting`;
  - `node scripts/check-step-collectors.mjs` and `node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs`, each plus its `--self-test`;
  - `pnpm check:stall-guard-budget`, `pnpm check:stall-guard-headroom` and `pnpm check:nul-bytes`;
  - `node scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs --self-test`;
  - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, run detached with its exit captured to a file: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1825 cases pass; 6 slow section(s) deferred.`
- **4 exit 3, NOT MEASURED:** `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` and `pnpm check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. Each refused with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` because there is no built `dist/`. This diff touches no package, and `Build Core` runs them on this PR.
- **Reconciliation:** `--ran` exits 0 with `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 57 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 53 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).`
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs --self-test`, which imports this module, exits 0.
- **ESLint, narrowed and measured:**
  - `eslint --no-inline-config --format json scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` lints 1 file with 0 errors;
  - the file is in eslint's own population (`--print-config` returns a config for it);
  - type-aware linting is not enabled for it (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict;
  - `ci.yml` is not linted by eslint.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ruled not extended:** the whole-matrix path with zero attestations keeps #3668's count-based pass, without a cause read (ruling `6097061442`). A matrix whose every shard was killed by its own timeout, with nothing attested, therefore still reads green. The seat's addendum measured that shape 0 times in the window.
- **NOT MEASURED:** a real job `GITHUB_TOKEN` performing the two reads from `test-gate`. The permissions rest on GitHub's documented ledger, as on PR #22666, and a refusal reads red, never green. This PR's own CI reaches the path only if a newer push supersedes its Test Core matrix after a shard attested.
- **Request cost:** a partial supersession of `Test Core` makes 1 jobs-list read plus up to 5 annotation reads under the job token. Every other run makes none.
- **A comment outside the file surface goes stale:** the claim forbids editing any other job, so `dogfood-gate` is not touched here.
  - Its permissions comment says the two reads pay for ONE question, about `dogfood-verify`.
  - Its token comment says the token is read only on the cancelled-single-leg path.
  - After this PR, both are also used for a partially attested `dogfood` matrix.
  - Suggested wording for whoever next touches that job: "… asked when `dogfood-verify` reads `cancelled` with zero attestations beside an attested sibling, or when the dogfood matrix reads `cancelled` after at least one shard attested (#22653) …".
- **The gate-only re-run edge**, carried from PR #22666: on an attempt where the cancelled shards were not themselves re-run, whether `attempts/N/jobs` lists them is NOT MEASURED. If it does not, the gate goes red; it does not go green.
